SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF('{{ $json.quicklink_id || "" }}', '') AS quicklink_id_raw,
    '{{ $json.phone }}'::text AS phone,
    '{{ $json.to_phone || "" }}'::text AS to_phone,
    '{{ $json.marca }}'::text AS marca
), norm AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN quicklink_id_raw ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN quicklink_id_raw::integer END AS quicklink_id,
    phone,
    to_phone,
    marca
  FROM input
)
SELECT l.id as lead_id, l.quicklink_id, l.nombre_cliente, l.telefono_1, l.modelo, l.marca::text as marca,
  COALESCE(c.mensajes_bienvenida, '[]'::jsonb) as mensajes_bienvenida,
  COALESCE(c.servicio_marca, '') as servicio_marca,
  -- ==================================================================
  -- FASE 1 opt-in/opt-out (PLAN_CRIS04_OPT_IN_OPT_OUT.md)
  -- Estado de consentimiento del numero a contactar.
  --
  -- Se busca por DOS caminos independientes, a proposito: si uno falla el
  -- otro sigue protegiendo. leads_quicklink.telefono_1 guarda el numero
  -- LOCAL sin codigo de pais (ej. '967393457 -'), mientras que
  -- lead_consent.phone_digits guarda E.164 (ej. '593967393457'), asi que
  -- comparar digitos crudos NUNCA cruza. Verificado 2026-08-20:
  -- 0/6323 por digitos crudos, 953/6323 normalizando.
  --   1) to_phone: el numero que realmente se va a mensajear.
  --   2) telefono_1 normalizado con la misma regla que normalizeWaPhone()
  --      del nodo 'Guardar Conversacion Supabase': si no arranca con un
  --      codigo de pais conocido, se le antepone 593.
  -- Gana el estado mas restrictivo. Sin fila => UNKNOWN, que no bloquea.
  -- ==================================================================
  COALESCE((
    SELECT lc.consent_status
    FROM lead_consent lc
    WHERE lc.phone_digits IN (
      regexp_replace(coalesce(n.to_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'),
      CASE
        WHEN regexp_replace(coalesce(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g') ~ '^(593|52|55|57)'
          THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
        WHEN regexp_replace(coalesce(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g') = ''
          THEN NULL
        ELSE '593' || regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '^0+', '')
      END
    )
    ORDER BY CASE lc.consent_status
      WHEN 'OPTED_OUT' THEN 0
      WHEN 'PENDING'   THEN 1
      WHEN 'OPTED_IN'  THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END
    LIMIT 1
  ), 'UNKNOWN') AS consent_status
FROM leads_quicklink l
JOIN norm n ON true
LEFT JOIN configuracion_marcas c ON c.marca = l.marca::text AND c.activo = true
WHERE l.marca::text = n.marca
  AND (
    (n.quicklink_id IS NOT NULL AND l.quicklink_id = n.quicklink_id)
    OR (
      n.quicklink_id IS NULL
      AND regexp_replace(coalesce(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g') IN (regexp_replace(n.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), n.to_phone)
    )
  )
ORDER BY l.created_at ASC
LIMIT 1

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ $json.lead_id }}'::uuid AS lead_id,
    '{{ $json.marca }}'::text AS marca,
    NULLIF('+{{ $('Guardar Conversacion Supabase').first().json.to_phone }}', '+')::text AS telefono,
    {{ $json.quicklink_id || 'NULL' }}::integer AS quicklink_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.nombre_cliente || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')::text AS nombre,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.modelo || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')::text AS modelo
), existing_before AS (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM conversaciones c
  JOIN input i ON c.lead_id = i.lead_id
), upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO conversaciones (lead_id, marca, canal, estado, intentos_realizados, telefono, quicklink_id, nombre, modelo)
  SELECT lead_id, marca, 'WHATSAPP', 'CONTACTED_1', 1, telefono, quicklink_id, nombre, modelo
  FROM input
  WHERE lead_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id) WHERE lead_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET
    telefono = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.telefono, conversaciones.telefono),
    quicklink_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.quicklink_id, conversaciones.quicklink_id),
    nombre = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nombre, conversaciones.nombre),
    modelo = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.modelo, conversaciones.modelo),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id AS conv_id, lead_id
), fallback AS (
  SELECT c.id AS conv_id, c.lead_id
  FROM conversaciones c
  JOIN input i ON c.lead_id = i.lead_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upserted)
  LIMIT 1
), conv AS (
  SELECT u.conv_id, u.lead_id, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_before) AS is_new
  FROM upserted u
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.conv_id, f.lead_id, false AS is_new
  FROM fallback f
), lead_updated AS (
  UPDATE leads_quicklink l
  SET conversacion_id = conv.conv_id,
      estado_agente = 'EN_GESTION',
      updated_at = now()
  FROM conv
  WHERE l.id = conv.lead_id
  RETURNING l.id
)
SELECT conv.conv_id,
       conv.lead_id,
       conv.is_new,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_updated) AS lead_linked
FROM conv
LIMIT 1

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH intro_seed AS (
  SELECT ('intro_cta_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''))::text AS interaction_id
), marked AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_memory (
    phone,
    lead_id,
    conversation_id,
    conversation_state,
    source,
    outbound_sequence_status,
    customer_engaged,
    followup_at,
    last_inbound_message_at,
    last_outbound_message_at,
    last_message_at,
    last_template_sent,
    last_template_sent_at,
    chatwoot_conv_id,
    chatwoot_contact_id
  ) VALUES (
    ('+' || regexp_replace('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.to_phone }}', '^\+', ''))::text,
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.lead_id }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    'CONTACTED_1',
    'outbound',
    'ACTIVE',
    false,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    now(),
    now(),
    '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_final || $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}'::text,
    now(),
    {{ $('Log Campaign to Chatwoot').first().json.cw_conv_id || 'NULL' }}::integer,
    {{ $('Log Campaign to Chatwoot').first().json.cw_contact_id || 'NULL' }}::integer
  )
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    lead_id = EXCLUDED.lead_id,
    conversation_id = EXCLUDED.conversation_id,
    conversation_state = 'CONTACTED_1',
    source = 'outbound',
    outbound_sequence_status = 'ACTIVE',
    customer_engaged = false,
    followup_at = NULL,
    last_inbound_message_at = NULL,
    last_outbound_message_at = now(),
    last_message_at = now(),
    last_template_sent = EXCLUDED.last_template_sent,
    last_template_sent_at = now(),
    chatwoot_conv_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.chatwoot_conv_id, lead_memory.chatwoot_conv_id),
    chatwoot_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.chatwoot_contact_id, lead_memory.chatwoot_contact_id),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
), eligible AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM marked
  WHERE customer_engaged = FALSE
    AND COALESCE(outbound_sequence_status, 'ACTIVE') <> 'PAUSED'
), state_result AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM set_conversation_state('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid, 'CONTACTED_1', 'cris_outbound_intake', jsonb_build_object('workflow', 'CRIS-04', 'template', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_final || $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}'))
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible)
), updated AS (
  UPDATE conversaciones
  SET
      chatwoot_conv_id = COALESCE((SELECT chatwoot_conv_id FROM marked LIMIT 1), conversaciones.chatwoot_conv_id),
      chatwoot_contact_id = COALESCE((SELECT chatwoot_contact_id FROM marked LIMIT 1), conversaciones.chatwoot_contact_id),
      variante_mensaje = CASE '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_variant || '' }}'
        WHEN 'v1' THEN 'A'
        WHEN 'v2' THEN 'B'
        WHEN 'v3' THEN 'C'
        ELSE conversaciones.variante_mensaje
      END,
      active_interaction_id = (SELECT interaction_id FROM intro_seed),
      active_interaction_type = 'INTRO_CTA',
      expected_action = 'INTRO_ACCEPT,INTRO_REJECT',
      interaction_consumed = false,
      conversation_version = COALESCE(conversaciones.conversation_version, 0) + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid
    AND lead_id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.lead_id }}'::uuid
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM state_result WHERE changed OR reason = 'no_change')
  RETURNING id
), lead_updated AS (
  UPDATE leads_quicklink
  SET estado_agente = 'EN_GESTION',
      conversacion_id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.lead_id }}'::uuid
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible)
  RETURNING id
), attempt_logged AS (
  INSERT INTO intentos_contacto (conversacion_id, numero_intento, mensaje_enviado, enviado_at, resultado, whatsapp_msg_id)
  SELECT
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    1,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_final || $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}', ''), 'CONTACTED_1'),
    now(),
    'ENVIADO'::resultado_intento,
    NULLIF('{{ $('Send WhatsApp Template').first().json.messages?.[0]?.id || '' }}', '')
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible)
  ON CONFLICT (conversacion_id, numero_intento) DO UPDATE SET
    mensaje_enviado = EXCLUDED.mensaje_enviado,
    enviado_at = COALESCE(intentos_contacto.enviado_at, EXCLUDED.enviado_at),
    resultado = CASE
      WHEN intentos_contacto.resultado = 'RESPONDIDO'::resultado_intento THEN intentos_contacto.resultado
      ELSE 'ENVIADO'::resultado_intento
    END,
    whatsapp_msg_id = COALESCE(intentos_contacto.whatsapp_msg_id, EXCLUDED.whatsapp_msg_id)
  RETURNING id
), scheduled AS (
  INSERT INTO scheduled_followups (conversation_id, phone, tipo_followup, scheduled_at, status, metadata)
  SELECT
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    ('+' || regexp_replace('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.to_phone }}', '^\+', ''))::text,
    'CONTACTED_2',
    outbound_followup_scheduled_at('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid, 'CONTACTED_2', now()),
    'PENDING',
    jsonb_build_object('country_code', NULLIF(NULLIF('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.country_code }}', 'undefined'), ''))
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_id, tipo_followup) WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), intro_interaction AS (
  INSERT INTO conversation_interactions (
    interaction_id, conversation_id, interaction_type, state, allowed_actions,
    conversation_version, payload
  )
  SELECT
    (SELECT interaction_id FROM intro_seed),
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    'INTRO_CTA',
    'AWAITING_INTRO_RESPONSE',
    ARRAY['INTRO_ACCEPT','INTRO_REJECT']::text[],
    COALESCE((SELECT conversation_version FROM conversaciones WHERE id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid), 0),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'template_name', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_final || $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}',
      'intro_template_name', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_intro || '' }}',
      'cta_template_name', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_cta || '' }}',
      'cta_variant', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_variant || '' }}',
      'brand', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.marca || '' }}'
    )
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
  ON CONFLICT (interaction_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING interaction_id
)
SELECT 'followup_programado' as action,
       '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}' as conversation_id,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked) as memory_linked,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_updated) as lead_marked,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempt_logged) as attempt_logged,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scheduled) as followup_scheduled,
       (SELECT interaction_id FROM intro_interaction LIMIT 1) as active_interaction_id;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
-- ============================================================================
-- FASE 3 opt-in/opt-out (PLAN_CRIS04_OPT_IN_OPT_OUT.md)
-- Contraparte de B1 para la rama de opt-in.
--
-- Diferencias con B1 - Programar Followup CONTACTO_2:
--   * NO programa el followup CONTACTED_2. Todavia no hay consentimiento.
--   * NO crea la interaccion INTRO_CTA; crea una OPTIN con sus propias
--     acciones permitidas, que es contra lo que la RPC valida el boton.
--   * Escribe lead_consent en PENDING para que el gate de la Fase 1 no
--     reenvie el opt-in en la proxima corrida.
-- ============================================================================
WITH optin_seed AS (
  SELECT ('optin_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''))::text AS interaction_id
), consent AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_consent (
    phone, consent_status, consent_source, last_optin_sent_at, lead_id, conversation_id
  ) VALUES (
    ('+' || regexp_replace('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.to_phone }}', '^\+', ''))::text,
    'PENDING',
    'optin_template',
    now(),
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.lead_id }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid
  )
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    -- Nunca degradar un OPTED_OUT a PENDING: una baja pedida manda siempre.
    consent_status = CASE
      WHEN lead_consent.consent_status = 'OPTED_OUT' THEN 'OPTED_OUT'
      ELSE 'PENDING'
    END,
    consent_source = 'optin_template',
    last_optin_sent_at = now(),
    lead_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lead_id, lead_consent.lead_id),
    conversation_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.conversation_id, lead_consent.conversation_id),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING phone, consent_status
), marked AS (
  -- lead_memory tiene que existir para que la respuesta del cliente entre por
  -- el AI y no por el flujo de lead frio. Mismo criterio que B1.
  INSERT INTO lead_memory (
    phone, lead_id, conversation_id, conversation_state, source,
    outbound_sequence_status, customer_engaged, followup_at,
    last_inbound_message_at, last_outbound_message_at, last_message_at,
    last_template_sent, last_template_sent_at
  ) VALUES (
    ('+' || regexp_replace('{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.to_phone }}', '^\+', ''))::text,
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.lead_id }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    'CONTACTED_1',
    'outbound',
    'ACTIVE',
    false,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    now(),
    now(),
    '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}'::text,
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    lead_id = EXCLUDED.lead_id,
    conversation_id = EXCLUDED.conversation_id,
    conversation_state = 'CONTACTED_1',
    source = 'outbound',
    outbound_sequence_status = 'ACTIVE',
    customer_engaged = false,
    followup_at = NULL,
    last_inbound_message_at = NULL,
    last_outbound_message_at = now(),
    last_message_at = now(),
    last_template_sent = EXCLUDED.last_template_sent,
    last_template_sent_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING phone
), state_result AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM set_conversation_state(
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    'CONTACTED_1',
    'cris_outbound_optin',
    jsonb_build_object('workflow', 'CRIS-04', 'step', 'optin', 'template', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}')
  )
), updated AS (
  -- Verificado en produccion 2026-08-22: la RPC de claim SOLO limpia
  -- active_interaction_type cuando es TOPIC_SELECTION. Si aca dejamos 'OPTIN',
  -- queda pegado despues de consumir el boton, y el gancho siguiente
  -- (INTRO_CTA) choca contra el y se descarta como 'stale_interaction_type'.
  -- Observado: OPTIN_GRANT PROCESSED 00:40:38 -> gancho STALE 00:40:55.
  -- Por eso el slot se deja LIMPIO. La interaccion OPTIN igual se consume,
  -- porque la RPC tambien matchea por (conversation_id, interaction_type,
  -- status='ACTIVE'), que es como se inserta abajo.
  UPDATE conversaciones
  SET active_interaction_id = NULL,
      active_interaction_type = NULL,
      expected_action = NULL,
      interaction_consumed = false,
      conversation_version = COALESCE(conversaciones.conversation_version, 0) + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid
    AND lead_id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.lead_id }}'::uuid
    -- Verificado en produccion 2026-08-21: set_conversation_state devuelve
    -- reason = 'unchanged' (no 'no_change') cuando el estado ya es el pedido.
    -- Como 'Postgres - Crear Conversacion' ya deja la conversacion en
    -- CONTACTED_1, esta guarda nunca se cumplia y la interaccion OPTIN no se
    -- creaba. Se aceptan ambas grafias.
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM state_result WHERE changed OR reason IN ('no_change', 'unchanged'))
  RETURNING id
), attempt_logged AS (
  INSERT INTO intentos_contacto (
    conversacion_id, numero_intento, mensaje_enviado, enviado_at, resultado, whatsapp_msg_id
  )
  SELECT
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    1,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}', ''), 'OPTIN'),
    now(),
    'ENVIADO'::resultado_intento,
    NULLIF('{{ $('Send WhatsApp Template').first().json.messages?.[0]?.id || '' }}', '')
  ON CONFLICT (conversacion_id, numero_intento) DO UPDATE SET
    mensaje_enviado = EXCLUDED.mensaje_enviado,
    enviado_at = COALESCE(intentos_contacto.enviado_at, EXCLUDED.enviado_at),
    whatsapp_msg_id = COALESCE(intentos_contacto.whatsapp_msg_id, EXCLUDED.whatsapp_msg_id)
  RETURNING id
), optin_interaction AS (
  INSERT INTO conversation_interactions (
    interaction_id, conversation_id, interaction_type, state, status,
    allowed_actions, conversation_version, payload
  )
  SELECT
    (SELECT interaction_id FROM optin_seed),
    '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid,
    'OPTIN',
    'AWAITING_OPTIN_RESPONSE',
    'ACTIVE',
    ARRAY['OPTIN_GRANT','OPTIN_DENY']::text[],
    COALESCE((SELECT conversation_version FROM conversaciones WHERE id = '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}'::uuid), 0),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'template_name', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.template_name_used }}',
      'brand', '{{ $('Prepare Template Payload').first().json.marca || '' }}',
      'step', 'optin'
    )
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
  ON CONFLICT (interaction_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING interaction_id
)
SELECT 'optin_registrado' AS action,
       '{{ $('Code - Armar Output').first().json.conv_id }}' AS conversation_id,
       (SELECT consent_status FROM consent LIMIT 1) AS consent_status,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked) AS memory_linked,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS conversation_marked,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempt_logged) AS attempt_logged,
       (SELECT interaction_id FROM optin_interaction LIMIT 1) AS active_interaction_id;
